breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not include the erroneous instruction about interpreting Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints with dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1). Instead, it correctly specifies Nx=1024 points on the periodic domain [0,1), which aligns with the ground truth's periodic grid convention (dx=1/Nx, no duplicated endpoint). The contradictory preamble instruction was effectively discarded.
